name: Administration
signature: Contract Automation, Works Foreman, payout +5% to +10% steps.
pitch: The Foreman costs less than your attention.

name: Logistics
identity: Fix things faster than they break
signature: Bot speed, repair speed, parts warehouses, Fleet Command.
pitch: Failures are scheduled. Repair time is the only variable.

name: Power
signature: Grid 1.5 MW, then 3.5, 9, 20. Every rack needs it first.
pitch: Every rack is a promise in kilowatts.

name: Cooling
identity: Move heat out, in three lines: Air, Liquid and Immersion
signature: Air tops out near 40 kW a cabinet. Liquid reaches 420 PF per cabinet, and the Mind Lattice 1,400 PF.
pitch: Air is cheap. Water is dense. Immersion is both a solution and a plumbing problem.

name: Compute
signature: Rear-door, cold-plate, blade, specialist cards (IA-1: 2.64 PF/kW).

name: Wetware
signature: OC-1: 135 PF at 24 kW = 5.6 PF/kW, over ten times AC-1. Brings contamination and mutations.
pitch: Eleven times the output per kilowatt. The tissue is fully under control.

name: Green
signature: Solar, wind, heat export, algae. Green Score rises with weather power share.
pitch: Free energy, until sundown. Keep a generator warm.

name: Synthetic
signature: PH-1 Photonic: 480 PF at 40 kW = 12 PF/kW. ML-1 Mind Lattice: 700 PF.
pitch: The fastest racks in the building. They have opinions about uptime.
